title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively removing some features from the model. How might this affect the model's variance?

title: Effect of LASSO on Model Complexity
text: Consider how reducing the number of features in a model might impact its complexity. A simpler model often has lower variance. Think about how LASSO regularization, which can reduce the number of features, might influence this.

title: Choosing the Effect on Model Variance
text: What is the possible effect of using LASSO regularization on model variance?
